rules.title: Decline windows closed late by the sweep

annotations.summary: The sweep, not their own timers, closed more than 10 decline windows in an hour: timers on the quote-timers queue are being lost ({{ $labels.deployment_environment }}).
annotations.runbook: Quote timers are being lost: check the quote-timers queue on the queues dashboard, Redis memory and eviction, and the worker logs.

rules.title: Booking, request and approval timers run late by the sweep

annotations.summary: The sweep, not their own timers, lapsed bookings or expired waiting garages, requests, quotes and assistant approvals, more than 10 in an hour: timers on the booking-timers, request-timers or assistant-approval-timers queue are being lost ({{ $labels.deployment_environment }}).
annotations.runbook: Booking or request timers are being lost: check the booking-timers, request-timers and assistant-approval-timers queues on the queues dashboard, Redis memory and eviction, and the worker logs.

model.expr: sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(motorfix_booking_lapses_total{job=~"(.+/)?worker", sweep="true"}[1h]) or increase(motorfix_request_timers_total{job=~"(.+/)?worker", sweep="true", step=~"recipient_expired|request_closed|quote_expired"}[1h]) or increase(motorfix_assistant_approvals_total{job=~"(.+/)?worker", outcome="expired", sweep="true"}[1h]))
